Chapter 6656: How Unbecoming

Chapter 6656: How Unbecoming

The gate opening surprised everyone.

“What’s happening?” All eyes were on the gate. Did this mean anyone could enter and distract the lord now?

“The gate is open for you, guest who traveled far to visit us. We apologize for the lack of reception.” A pleasant voice came from above, evoking the image of a gentle, softspoken lady.

However, something about her voice commanded respect as if she were sitting on a throne. She was born noble and dignified but this didn’t make her arrogant.

Overlords didn’t dare to offend her, let alone weaker cultivators. Many cultivators bowed without seeing her.

“Your Majesty, the Lord of Life and Death.” Everyone knew who she was. After all, they have heard stories of her innate nobility and greatness.

Although she was not an immortal, she towered over them. Desolate Ancestor, Zhan Sansheng, and the two immortals from the redemption grounds viewed her as an equal.

“Seeing her is a lifetime of fortune.” Someone said.

A figure casting a long shadow appeared before the gate, seemingly attempting to block anything from leaving.

“Did I make a fool out of myself, Your Majesty? I recall my past self, Luminous, was never one to resort to petty trickery.” The figure said.

“Primal Yin Immortal Ghost!” Others recognized him.

“Luminous Master.” An ancient cultivator mourned.

In terms of fame, Primal Yin Immortal Ghost proved superior because he was an overlord. Lumionus Master was only an apex primal ancestor stuck with extinguishment.

Alas, Luminous Master garnered more respect. He was vibrant and full of vigor. Youthful arrogance and the wildness of life radiated energetically. Those more powerful than him marveled at his existence.

Both friends and foes appreciated the colors he added to their world. On the other hand, Primal Yin Immortal Ghost resembled a serpent lurking in a damp, pitch-black cave.

“You were a great genius of Three Immortals. During your prime, we were merely insignificant figures.” The lord said.

These words caused the ghost to stiffen. In a sense, his previous life was far more magnificent despite being weaker.

“I’m ashamed, Your Majesty.” He remarked, unable to regain his former prestige.

“Senior Bao Pu?” She said.

Spectators looked around and there was no second visitor outside of Luminous Master.

“Bao Pu is here?” They became confused.

“Must be, they can’t stop an immortal so might as well open the gate.” A heaven-slayer said.

“I see, that’s an interesting move.” Others commented.

“I, Chuqing, have never resorted to deceit, yet you are exercising such vigilance, Senior Bao Pu. I apologize to have made you suspicious.” She said.

Those who listened to her felt their blood swelling. Something about her voice was immensely charismatic, not to mention her humility.

The voice was distant and unpredictable, as if coming from all directions.

“Bao Pu, it’s Bao Pu!” Someone recognized the voice of the legendary being.

He was rumored to be the first cultivator in their world. Although Desolate Ancestor created the current system, he was the one who started cultivation with the help of the three immortals.

Although his system was inferior, his contributions to the world in the forgotten past were undeniable.
